def coherentDiagramTotalKanObject (F : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj B ⟶ SpaceInfinity.{u}) : KanObject.{u} := ⟨coherentDiagramTotalKan F, inferInstance⟩
def coherentDiagramTotalVertex (F : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj B ⟶ SpaceInfinity.{u}) : SpaceInfinity.{u} _⦋0⦌ := spaceInfinityVertex (coherentDiagramTotalKanObject F)

lemma coherentDiagramTotalVertex_object (F : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj B ⟶ SpaceInfinity.{u}) : (spaceInfinityObject (coherentDiagramTotalVertex F)).obj = coherentDiagramTotalKan F := congrArg (fun K : KanObject.{u} ↦ K.obj) (spaceInfinityVertexEquiv.left_inv (coherentDiagramTotalKanObject F))
def coherentDiagramTotalCocone (F : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj B ⟶ SpaceInfinity.{u}) : JoinCocone F := (coherentTotalCoconeRealization F).cocone

lemma coherentDiagramTotalCocone_vertex (F : (SSet.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj B ⟶ SpaceInfinity.{u}) : (coherentDiagramTotalCocone F).vertex = coherentDiagramTotalVertex F := (coherentTotalCoconeRealization F).vertex_eq
def markedSeed : X.Subcomplex := A ⊔ inverseWitnessSeed s hs
instance small_markedSeed [∀ d, Small.{u} (A.obj d)] [Small.{u} ι] (d : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ) : Small.{u} ((markedSeed A s hs).obj d)
